data.heading: What we build
data.intro: Three lines of work, all run by the same crew. We do fewer projects a year on purpose — so every one of them is worth a callback.

items.title: Design-build custom homes
items.description: From a blank lot to a finished home in 14–18 months. We handle architecture, engineering, permitting, and construction under one roof — no general-contractor handoff, no finger-pointing.

items.title: Whole-house renovations
items.description: Mid-century, farmhouse, lake cottage — we work on the bones of older buildings without losing what makes them feel like home. Specialists in additions that don't look like additions.
